body.message:
Certainly, we can arrange the booking for December for one month (30 nights).

Regarding the additional 3 nights from 31st December to 2nd January, please allow me some time to check the availability and rates and I will update you accordingly. As New Year’s Eve falls within this period, the rates are significantly different, so we will need to check and confirm the applicable rate before proceeding.

Thank you for your understanding and patience.
